title: Flat cartoon
summary: A 24 s narrated idea explainer in a flat-vector cartoon look: one original character acts out four beats in two generated Seedance clips, one narration line per shot, captions always on.

optional.BYTEPLUS_API_KEY (Seedream 4.0 and Seeda: a new character still and new clips

craft: four beats: easy case, hard case, what goes wrong, what it means for you
one narration line per shot, 15-17 plain words
captions switch at the narration's pauses
two shots per generated clip, one reference still for the character
clip sound as the bed under the voice

style.ground: dark violet, coral dusk and teal night scenes, generated
style.type: Inter 700 captions on a dark rounded box
style.accent: mint-green character against violet and coral
banned: characters, logos or looks taken from an existing channel
text written by the video model
code-drawn vector art standing in for illustration
style.motion: whatever the generated shots do; the edit is two hard cuts inside clips and one between them

generators: Seedance 2.0 (BytePlus) two 12 s clips, 720p, with sound, the still as reference image
ElevenLabs multilingual v2 narration via fal, one file per line
tool.assets: tools/build.py mixes the sound and writes index.html from film.json

reference.name: flat-vector science channels in general; no single film

result.example_story: why AI improves faster at math than at taste (a draft; its script is a known weak point, see RECIPE.md)

from_story: one idea that a character can act out in four shots
four approved narration lines before anything is generated

fits: short explainers of an idea, a mechanism or a trade-off
a brand's point of view told without real people
avoid: true stories about real people or events (use paper-collage)
product launches that need real screens
anything where text must appear inside the picture
